varieties.name: California Wonder
varieties.traits: Sweet-tasting blocky fruit, green ripening to red; full sunlight
varieties.note: The classic, widely-sold, open-pollinated (seed-saveable) bell/sweet pepper in South Africa — a genuine addition since crop-catalog.ts had no prior varieties array for peppers. Directly fetched and confirmed by name, unlike most other Starke Ayres pages checked in this task which returned only a JS-rendered shell.

evidence.quote: California Wonder This vegetable seed produces sweet-tasting blocky fruit turning from green to red when mature. Planting Season Spring & Summer Location Full Sunlight Germination 10 - 14 Days Maturity 75 - 80 Days
evidence.doc: California Wonder, Starke Ayres product page (fetched directly, verbatim — page content, not just the nav shell, was recovered on this attempt)
